title: He will carry you

verses.text: Even to your old age, I will be the same, and I will bear you up when you turn gray. I have made you, and I will carry you; I will sustain you and deliver you.
Blessed be the Lord, who daily bears our burden, the God of our salvation. Selah
and in the wilderness, where the LORD your God carried you, as a man carries his son, all the way by which you traveled until you reached this place.”

caption:
Some days you are not the one carrying the weight. You are the one being carried.

God does not hand out strength and then walk away. He bears you up, day after day, from your first steps to your gray hair. The arms that made you are the same arms holding you now.

Isaiah 46:4, Psalm 68:19, Deuteronomy 1:31 (BSB)

Save this for the day the weight comes back. Send it to someone who has been carrying a lot lately.
